purpose.zh: 在L撑中练双腿开合控制
purpose.en: Practise opening and closing your legs in an L-sit.

text.zh: 双手撑地顶起身体，伸直的腿开合
text.en: Press up on your hands and open and close your straight legs
Press your shoulders down and lock your arms.

text.zh: 腿保持离地，动作慢而稳
text.en: Keep your legs off the floor and move slowly and steadily.

commonErrors.en: Bending the knees or letting the feet touch down.

cautions.zh: 手腕热身后再做；腕部或肩部疼痛时缩短时间或改简单版本
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first; if your wrists or shoulders hurt, shorten the hold or use an easier version.
